title: An Introduction to the Literature of the Old Testament (1st ed.)

verification_log.method: pp. 81–82: Deuteronomy must have been written before the eighteenth year of Josiah (B.C. 621), when Hilkiah found the "book of the law"; that book "must have contained Deuteronomy" (covenant allusions, 23:2–3; the reform follows Dt step by step); Hilkiah's authorship improbable; composition "not later than the reign of Manasseh"; p. 183: the prophecy against the altar of Bethel (1 Kgs 13) is "a narrative not probably of very early origin", the names of both prophets being no longer remembered

access_notes: Read through the Internet Archive OCR text of the 1891 first edition.
